data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, regardless of others; each of you may independently join or choose otherwise. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). This risks lower future income, not guaranteed optimality. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Fisher15/20/09/07, help recruit. Everyone: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
